Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike.

  • Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not.

  • Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible.

  • Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use.

  • Give our Applications Engineers and the team a clear verdict on each measurement, and feed what breaks back into the next generation of the QDm.

 

What is expected of you

  • 3+ years of professional experience outside academia applying data science to measurement or imaging data from physical instruments.

  • A degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline; a PhD is welcome, not required.

  • Solid statistics and signal or image processing: you ask where a signal comes from, tell it from noise and systematics, and show it with numbers.

  • Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, with version control and tests as a habit.

  • AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

  • Comfortable operating our systems in the lab when your analysis needs data.

  • Fluent English; German is an advantage, not a requirement. On-site in Munich.

Experience with magnetic or electromagnetic measurements or semiconductor failure analysis is a plus. What we cannot teach on the job is rigor with real measurement data and the habit of turning one analysis into a method the team can reuse, and that is exactly what we want you to bring.

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

description:

Our independence is what really sets us apart - we provide objective, unbiased intelligence that our clients trust and depend on.

Neudata’s research team is at the core of what we do. Clients of Neudata have access to:

  • Our research portal, allowing them to browse our catalogue of dataset reports, each of which is written by a member of the research team and pertaining to a dataset (e.g. short positions data by vendor X)

  • Our research team’s expertise, allowing us to help them make informed data decisions (e.g. through calls where we share our opinion on the most appropriate dataset for their needs)

Your work will centre on translating complex, non-traditional datasets into actionable intelligence in a highly collaborative and inquisitive role that requires a blend of analytical thinking and clear, authoritative communication.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental policies 🏠

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

  • 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

  • A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

  • Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

  • Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

  • A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

  • Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

  • The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.


About the team

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 
 

About the role

 

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards.

 

This is an ambitious, cross-functional role requiring a blend of technical expertise, engineering leadership, and confident client-facing skills.

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML systems

  • Designing and building production-grade ML software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

  • Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies

  • Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You understand the full ML lifecycle and have significant experience operationalising models built with frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch

  • You bring deep expertise in software engineering and strong Python skills, focusing on building robust, reusable systems

  • You have demonstrable hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture, security, and infrastructure

  • You've extensive experience working with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale

  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, demonstrating ownership and autonomy in driving projects to completion

  • You communicate exceptionally well, confidently guiding both technical teams and senior, non-technical stakeholders

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)


#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Lead Analytics Engineer
description:
Do you love turning messy business questions into data people can trust? Can you connect the customer journey from the first marketing touch through sales conversion, revenue, retention, and product usage and explain the numbers equally clearly to an engineer, a CMO, and a CFO? AIHR is looking for a Lead Agentic Analytics Engineer to become the hands-on functional lead of our two-person Data & Analytics team. You will own the translation of cross-functional business questions into trusted metrics, governed semantic models, and decision-ready agentic analytics; set the analytical direction; and build the most critical models yourself. You are transforming raw data into governed products that drive decision-making for our business partners.

 

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the global market leader in online training for HR professionals. We support customers in more than 140 countries, including organizations such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to continuously upskill and empower one million HR professionals.

Today, we are an international team of more than 100 people representing over 30 nationalities. We are driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow, while staying friendly, enthusiastic, and committed to helping each other succeed.

Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows.


Role and Responsibilities

AIHR's Data & Analytics team is part of Business Operations. You will work alongside Vahid, our Senior Data Engineer, and report to Leo, our VP of Business Operations. Our ingestion and warehouse foundation is largely established: data from systems such as HubSpot and our own LMS moves through ETL pipelines into Snowflake. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools.

Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business.

This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. It is designed for someone who wants to lead through expertise while remaining close to the work.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own and execute a rolling one-year Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing urgent business needs with foundational work. Guide Vahid through clear priorities, design reviews, code review, and reusable modeling patterns.

  • Lead discovery across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to uncover the decision behind a request and translate it into agreed metric definitions, governed semantic layers, and data models that connect the full customer lifecycle.

  • Set the analytical architecture and dbt standards; design, build, test, and document the most critical governed models yourself using SQL and dbt.

  • Own the full-funnel measurement framework—from marketing reach, demand generation, attribution, and customer acquisition cost through lead and pipeline conversion, sales cycle, bookings, and revenue to onboarding, product adoption, expansion, renewal, churn, and customer lifetime value. Keep core recurring-revenue definitions finance-grade and reconciled while showing how upstream activity drives downstream customer outcomes.

  • Own the logic and quality behind executive dashboards and self-service analytics across Power BI, Metabase, and AI-enabled interfaces. Present the results to senior leaders, explain every assumption, and respond constructively to challenge.

  • Partner closely with Vahid on warehouse and pipeline requirements, resolve conflicting numbers at the source, and raise the technical quality of the team. Apply AI where it improves development speed or data access, while using sound judgment around privacy, governance, validation, and trust.

A Typical Week

This is a hands-on lead role. The exact balance will shift with business priorities, but you should expect roughly half your time to remain close to the data—building, reviewing, and investigating—and the rest to be split across discovery, functional leadership, and decision support.

  • Design or improve a dbt model that connects data across HubSpot, our LMS, billing, or other source systems; write the SQL, tests, documentation, and metric logic needed to put it into production.

  • Run discovery sessions with leaders in Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Finance to clarify the decision they need to make, challenge the requested metric, and agree on the definition.

  • Work side by side with Vahid on source-data requirements, architecture choices, and implementation; review code and unblock delivery without handing off all of the technical work.

  • Investigate a commercial or customer-lifecycle question, improve an executive or functional dashboard, and present the conclusion—including assumptions and limitations—to the relevant leadership team.

  • Reprioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, resolve competing requests, and invest in the semantic layer, governance, and reusable modeling foundations that reduce future ad hoc work.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first three months, you have established a clear operating model with Vahid, mapped ownership of the most important metrics, agreed the Data & Analytics roadmap, and resolved at least one material conflicting-number problem.

Within six months, AIHR has a governed customer-lifecycle domain in dbt and an executive view connecting acquisition and pipeline to revenue, retention, and product usage, and has launched the first MVP of our agentic analytics platform to drive self-serve adoption. The underlying definitions are documented, reconciled where relevant, and trusted across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance.

Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established.

Throughout, you remain hands-on in SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and analytics while setting direction, coaching through the work, and earning leadership's trust in both the numbers and the roadmap.

We offer

  • A high-impact role as the functional lead of a small Data & Analytics team, with end-to-end ownership of the semantic layer behind company-wide decisions.

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation.

  • Substantial autonomy to shape your day-to-day work, with regular growth conversations and support for your career goals.

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home arrangements after onboarding.

  • 26 paid holidays per year, plus one extra day for each of your first five years at AIHR.

  • The option to exchange any two public holidays for two days of your choice.

  • A work-from-anywhere policy that lets you work abroad for up to 20 days per calendar year.

  • A pension plan, four Trust Days for ad hoc recovery, and access to the OpenUp mental health platform.

  • A personal development budget, training opportunities, and the books you need to keep learning.

  • All public-transport expenses covered through an NS Business Card, plus a MacBook and the equipment you need.

  • A beautiful office opposite Rotterdam Central Station, a satellite office in Amsterdam, daily chef-prepared lunch, regular drinks, team activities, and free access to the office gym.

Get a taste of working at AIHR in our AIHR Benefits Guide.

Apply for the Job

Are you excited to become our Lead Analytics Engineer? We would love to hear from you. We are aiming for a start date in December 2026 or January 2027.

P.S. If this role excites you but you do not meet every point, we still encourage you to apply. We care about the evidence behind your experience and your potential to grow—not a perfect checklist.


Who you are

You are a hands-on technical leader: commercially sharp, calm under challenge, and confident enough to defend your numbers in any room. You also have the patience to build data foundations properly and raise the quality of the work around you.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience across analytics engineering, BI, data engineering, or business-facing analytics roles, including substantial recent hands-on analytics engineering and evidence of leading work beyond your own delivery.

  • You have a proven track record of building semantic layers or governed dimensional models end-to-end—from business discovery and metric definition to production models and adoption—not only dashboards.

  • You have expert SQL and data modeling skills, strong production experience with dbt, and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable warehouse, along with a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker, Omni, or Metabase.

  • You bring strong financial acumen, but your analytical experience extends across the full customer lifecycle. You can connect marketing acquisition and attribution, sales pipeline and conversion, revenue and unit economics, customer retention and expansion, and product adoption into one coherent model. You understand how bookings, billings, recognized revenue, cash, ARR, and NRR differ without treating financial reporting as the whole analytical problem.

  • You have worked in a B2B SaaS, subscription, fintech, or marketplace business and have modeled several stages of the funnel spanning marketing or growth, sales, customer success and retention, and product usage—rather than specializing in only one function.

  • You explain complex logic in plain language, push back constructively on senior stakeholders, and build trust without becoming defensive—even when you discover that your own number or assumption needs to change.

  • You take pride in driving the analytical roadmap and architectural vision, leading technical work through architecture and code review, and mentoring experienced colleagues without relying on formal authority. You want the majority of your role to remain hands-on.

  • You balance pragmatic execution with rigorous analysis, adapting precision levels to fit business needs and operational constraints.

  • You are used to leveraging a broad range of AI tools to boost your productivity and know how to configure them to produce output that lives up to our quality standards and best practices

Nice to Have

  • Earlier experience in RevOps, Growth, FP&A, product analytics, or commercial analytics, ideally combined with experience in a fast-growing scale-up.

  • Experience with HubSpot, marketing automation and attribution data, subscription or billing data, LMS or product-usage event data, Personio, or building semantic layers for AI-enabled and conversational analytics.

title: Data Engineer
description:
De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering.  

Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. 

 

Wat ga je doen?  

Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt.

Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken.

Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.

Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm
Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. Je kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen en klanten daarin meenemen, ook als het complex is. Daarin mag je best een tikkeltje eigenwijs zijn.


Nog geen doorgewinterde expert?

Geen probleem. Als je leergierig bent en en affiniteit hebt met data, komen we graag met je in contact.

Persoonlijke vaardigheden:

  • Analytisch sterk, je ziet snel verbanden in data en datastructuren

  • Leergierig en gedreven om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen

  • Zelfstandig maar samenwerkingsgericht, je pakt door zonder dat iemand je hoeft aan te sturen

  • Communicatief vaardig, je vertaalt technische keuzes naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten

  • Probleemoplossend, je zoekt structurele oplossingen in plaats van tijdelijke fixes

Professionele vaardigheden:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau in een technische of data-gerelateerde richting

  • 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring in data engineering of een vergelijkbare consultancy rol

  • Ervaring met ETL/ELT processen, data modeling en data pipelines

Pré:

  • Affiniteit met of kennis van Elastic, SQL of vergelijkbare data-platformen

  • Ervaring met data orchestration, data lakes of dashboarding tools

  • Kennis van cloud omgevingen zoals AWS of Azure

  • Begrijpt hoe data-architectuur bijdraagt aan AI-toepassingen en procesautomatisering


Waarom werken bij PuurData?

Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen werkweek in te richten en werkt aan uitdagende projecten bij uiteenlopende klanten, geen saaie repeterende klussen. Je werkt in een platte organisatie waar jouw mening telt en er snel geschakeld wordt. Daarnaast bieden we een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, pensioen zonder eigen bijdrage en volop ruimte om door te groeien.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they ildrive.

The team

Broker Terms is a growing team that sits within iwoca's third-party acquisition department. It owns the full offer terms strategy for customers referred through the broker network – both first-time customers and repeat. The team sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the UX that presents them to brokers and customers.

The team is small and interdisciplinary, combining commercial strategy, engineering, and data science. The work translates business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into actionable decisions. Active projects include:

  • Model-based pricing – creating a sophisticated model to offer bespoke pricing to each customer

  • A no-fee test – examining how our product performs when we remove all drawdown fees, and how that influence customer repayment behaviour

  • Testing longer-duration flexi-loan products with particular customer segments.

  • Reintroductions - exploring the right offer terms to give returning customers

The team is small and cross-functional – commercial strategy, engineering, design, and data science – and works across the full application stack, from the Broker API to the Introducer Portal brokers use.

The role

You'll model expected customer take-up rates, design experiments, and translate findings into pricing and product decisions for the acquisition channel that drives the most customer lifetime value (CLTV). Because the Broker Terms team is a young team, you'll influence how its analytical approach develops, not just what it produces.

The work has direct commercial consequences: brokers act on what the team builds and tests, and that shapes which customers iwoca wins and on what terms.

  • Offer terms and experimentation. You'll model how customers respond to offer terms and how brokers make decisions under uncertainty. You'll design experiments where causal inference is central: you'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Commercial translation. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and see your analysis applied directly in day-to-day decisions. That includes meeting brokers in person – gaining context that shapes how you frame and interpret results – and coordinating with adjacent teams responsible for underwriting decisions, repeat lending, and offer construction.

  • CLTV and customer journey. You'll think across the full broker-referred customer journey – from first funding to repeat – identifying what drives CLTV and what changes to offer terms or UX improve it. You own both the strategy and the mechanism, so your findings feed directly into what the team builds and tests.

  • AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work – not occasionally, but as a default. You should have a view on where it genuinely helps and where a different approach is better.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics. You're comfortable with Bayesian reasoning, and have applied hierarchical models or formal decision-making under uncertainty in real work.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You've separated signal from noise in observational and experimental data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. You have experience with careful experimental design to facilitate clean, trustworthy results.

  • Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the method, and landing the answer with the people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. You're proficient with data manipulation and modelling tools, and with scientific computing libraries (pandas, numpy, sklearn, PyMC).

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. You've built or adapted statistical or ML models and can explain the maths behind them to commercial stakeholders.

  • Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling.

  • Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

Your mission

 

You’ll join us as a Machine Learning Engineer/ Data Scientist for Mimica’s Data Intelligence team, whose goal is to transform raw recorded data into clean, structured, anonymized data that powers the work of other teams.

You’ll own key parts of our ML pipelines end to end, making them more accurate, cost-efficient, and trustworthy. Along the way, you’ll build evaluations and LLM judges, run experiments, and transform promising results into validated production improvements.

Your work will be applied and LLM-heavy, with opportunities to evaluate and fine-tune open-source models and build smaller, task-specific models.

If you enjoy taking ML beyond experiments, this is your chance to shape the systems at the heart of Mimica’s products and see your work deliver value to real users at scale.

 

Part of your day-to-day

 

  • Own, debug, and improve production pipelines for accuracy and efficiency.

  • Design, build, and iterate on LLM evals and LLM-as-a-judge systems, including the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to monitor quality.

  • Run rigorous experiments on prompts, pipeline design, model choice, and inputs (e.g., OCR text vs. image + OCR), and turn the results into clear recommendations.

  • Drive LLM efficiency improvements across our pipelines by comparing models, restructuring steps, and replacing LLM calls with smaller, purpose-built models where it makes sense.

  • Expand our anonymization pipeline, including evaluating and adapting existing models.

  • Work with Python and quality engineers to take experiments into production, and share responsibility for the code you ship.

  • Document findings in writing (eg. experiment reports, design docs)

 

What we’re looking for

 

Primarily, we’re looking for an individual with an experiment- and data-driven researcher mindset with good coding habits. This includes:

  • Solid machine learning/data science background: you understand experimental design, data splits, metrics, bias, and statistical significance, and you know when a result is real.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs in production or near-production settings, especially evaluating them: building eval sets, LLM judges and benchmarks, and iterating on prompts and pipelines against them.

  • Comfortable getting deep into messy data: exploring it, troubleshooting issues, and transforming insights into measurable improvements.

  • Strong Python and good engineering skills. You write clear, readable, tested code that others can take to production, even if you’re not the one owning the infrastructure.

  • Able to work independently on ambiguous problems: framing the question, choosing the approach, and deciding on the acceptance criteria to ship.

  • Use AI coding tools effectively and stay accountable for the output: understand, explain, and defend everything you ship.

  • Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including explaining technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

Bonus / Nice to have

  • Experience with classical ML or deep learning model development.

  • Experience with image/OCR pipelines or face-related anonymization

  • Experience shipping end-to-end ML features in a startup or scale-up environment.

 

Location

This is a fully remote position. To make sure we work well together, we’re only considering candidates based in the UK or Europe, in time zones compatible with London (typically UTC-1 to UTC+3).

title: Research Analyst
description:
About BeInCrypto

BeInCrypto is a part of the media group BeInNews Ltd, a global newsroom and research team covering institutional finance and digital assets as they intersect: regulation, trading infrastructure, and market structure - backed by original data and a team reporting from every major time zone. Our 100+ journalists and analysts operate across 50+ countries, publishing in 26 languages. We are official media partners at Money20/20, Digital Assets Forum London, Korea Blockchain Week, Token2049, Proof of Talk, and other leading industry events.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on Research Analyst to develop and deliver high-quality institutional research at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets. You will take ownership of the research process, from identifying relevant topics and analysing data to producing insightful, accurate, and publication-ready reports.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end-to-end research process, from identifying relevant topics and developing research angles to data analysis, report writing, and final quality control.

  • Produce clear, insightful, institutional-grade research reports covering traditional finance, digital assets, market trends, and emerging opportunities.

  • Critically evaluate data, challenge assumptions, identify inconsistencies, and ensure the accuracy and credibility of research findings, including AI-generated content.

  • Identify relevant industry trends, research opportunities, and insights that resonate with institutional audiences.

  • Collaborate with editorial, product, design, and commercial teams to develop valuable research products, including reports, indices, and premium research offerings.

  • Engage with industry experts and data providers when needed to gather insights, validate findings, and strengthen research quality.

You are the perfect match if you:

  • Have proven hands-on experience in traditional finance research, financial journalism, or market intelligence, ideally with exposure to digital assets.

  • Have experience working at an established financial research firm, financial institution, market intelligence provider, or leading financial media outlet.

  • Can independently manage research projects from initial analysis to a complete, publication-ready report.

  • Have strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, challenge conclusions, and develop original insights.

  • Can produce well-structured, accurate, and engaging research reports in fluent English.

  • Are confident working with financial data, research platforms, and AI tools while independently validating and improving their outputs.

  • Understand institutional financial markets and can identify research topics relevant to professional audiences.

  • Have a product mindset and understand how high-quality research can create value for audiences and support commercial opportunities.

What we offer to you:

  • 100% remote work with no location restrictions.

  • Flexible working hours with no time tracking and no mandatory meetings outside your timezone.

  • Paid time off to recharge.

  • Direct collaboration with the CEO and executive leadership on research strategy and institutional initiatives.

  • Access to leading data platforms and research tools, among which are Glassnode, CryptoQuant, Messari, DelphiDigital, LunarCrush, Nansen, Santiment, Dune, and others.

  • Opportunities to build your personal brand through speaking engagements, podcasts, conferences, and media appearances.

  • Access to major crypto and fintech events around the world.

  • Internal learning programs, masterclasses, and knowledge sharing.

  • Clear goals, measurable outcomes, and a data-driven culture where your work has a visible business impact.

  • An inclusive workplace where everyone, regardless of background, nationality, gender, identity, abilities, or beliefs, can thrive.

Meet our team:

You’ll be working with the Multimedia Global Newsroom team. Your manager will be Chief Global Strategy Officer. This team is the heart of BeInCrypto - reporting and original research on digital assets and institutional finance, published in 26 languages.

Ready to start your new journey with us?

At BIC, we value your ideas, curiosity, dynamism, adaptability, ownership mindset, passion for innovation and AI, awareness of industry trends, and ability to work autonomously and stay organized. If this approach resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team and achieve new heights together!

Recruitment process: Portfolio review → HR interview → Take-home assignment → Interview with our Managing Editor and Chief Global Strategy Officer → Offer.

Apply now, and our Recruitment team will contact you with the next steps.

title: Data Engineer H/F - Paris
description:
Nos missions :

Nous intervenons chez nos clients sur des missions 100% data qui allient des dimensions techniques et stratégiques, où la donnée est le moteur de la performance opérationnelle. En tant que Data Engineer, vous êtes l'architecte qui rend la donnée exploitable. Selon votre profil, vous interviendrez sur la construction de plateformes data robustes (Data Lakehouse) ou sur l'industrialisation de flux complexes destinés à l'IA.

Nos clients (Luxe, Retail, Télécom, Banque...) font face à une explosion des volumes et des sources de données. Votre rôle sera de garantir la fluidité, la qualité et la sécurité de ces flux.


Quelques exemples de sujets du moment :

  • Migration d'un legacy on-premise vers une architecture Cloud Lakehouse (Snowflake/Databricks). #CloudMigration

  • Industrialisation de pipelines complexes sur GCP (BigQuery, Dataform) avec une forte culture de l'observabilité (Dynatrace) et du CI/CD. #Orchestration

  • Déploiement d'applications, d’API et de services IA (Algorithmes de prédictions ML, agents conversationnels, etc.) #MLOps

  • Audit et refonte de pipelines d’ingestion pour réduire les coûts de calcul et de stockage sur GCP ou AWS. #Performance

  • Développement de composants Kafka, exposition via API et garantie de la performance des flux temps réel à l'échelle internationale. #Streaming




L'humain :

Nous recherchons des talents :

  • Ayant un excellent relationnel pour faire le pont entre les besoins métiers et les contraintes IT,

  • Avec la volonté de bâtir des infrastructures scalables et robustes,

  • Dotés d’un esprit d’analyse rigoureux,

  • Qui accordent une importance capitale à la qualité du code (CI/CD, tests unitaires) et à la documentation technique (Confluence/Jira),

  • Curieux des nouvelles tendances (DataOps, IA générative appliquée au code),

  • Sensibles aux enjeux RSE pour intégrer des pratiques numériques durables,

  • Avec l’envie de transmettre et d’apprendre au sein d’une communauté technique active,

  • Maîtrisant l'anglais professionnel pour intervenir dans des contextes internationaux,

  • Disposant de quatre années d'expérience minimum sur des sujets d'ingénierie de données.

Les compétences techniques :

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation data à l’université ou en grande école et :

  • Maîtrisez parfaitement Python et SQL (analytique et procédural),

  • Avez une solide expérience sur un orchestrateur de workflow (Airflow, Prefect ou Dagster),

  • Connaissez les outils de transformation moderne comme dbt (Data Build Tool),

  • Maîtrisez au moins une solution Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake) et ses services managés (BigQuery, Redshift, S3...),

  • Maîtrisez le cycle de vie logicielle (GitLab/GitHub, CI/CD, Terraform, Docker),

  • En bonus : vous avez déjà manipulé des flux de streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub), des frameworks d’IA générative (Langchain) ou des outils de Dataviz (Power BI).


Le processus de recrutement


  • Vous échangerez tout d’abord avec notre Talent acquisition Leader qui vous invitera à passer un premier entretien au téléphone, en visio ou sur site.

description:
La mission :

A travers le stage, vous aurez l'opportunité de mettre en pratique vos compétences, d'apprendre auprès d'experts, et de contribuer à des projets concrets et impactants.

Être consultant, c’est participer à des projets qui répondent à la fois à des enjeux techniques et à des problématiques orientées business, et qui concernent des secteurs d’activité variés (luxe, retail, banque/assurance, industrie, etc).

Nos missions allient une dimension technique et opérationnelle permettant d’approfondir vos connaissances sur des sujets novateurs. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée afin de développer et faire vivre les applications data stratégiques de nos clients. Lors de vos projets vous serez amené à travailler sur les éléments suivants : Recueil, Intégration, Structuration, Restitution.

  • Vous participerez à l’identification / investigation des données sources et à la mise en place des outils / connecteur d’alimentation (ETL / ELT),

  • Vous serez responsable de la structuration du modèle de données ainsi que de la transformation des données sources en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI),

  • Vous utiliserez des techniques de monitoring et des outils d'analyse / dataviz pour répondre aux besoins des équipes métiers.

  • Vous développerez vos compétences en programmation, combinées à votre proactivité, pour industrialiser et généraliser les analyses nécessaires.

Voici quelques exemples concrets de stages récents :

  • Retail : Implémentation de pipelines ELT avec DBT sur une plateforme Snowflake pour harmoniser les données, puis reconstruction des dashboards sur Tableau avec les nouvelles sources.

  • Luxe : Développement de tableaux de bord de suivi de la performance des modèles ML avec des outils de dataviz (ex: Looker et Grafana), s'appuyant sur des logs générés via Airflow.

  • Industrie énergétique : Refactorisation du code ETL pour utiliser des techniques plus efficaces (ex: parallélisation, optimisation SQL), et mise en place de tests unitaires et d'intégration pour garantir la fiabilité des données.

  • Assurance / Banque : Optimisation et maintenance d’un ETL lié à un rapport de solvabilité des sinistres

Lab’ AVISIA :

En complément de nos missions, nous menons divers projets internes qui alimentent notre recherche et développement. Ces projets nous donnent l'opportunité d'offrir à nos clients des approches analytiques innovantes, testées en grandeur nature.

Afin de soutenir ces initiatives, nous avons mis en place nos propres infrastructures. Nos consultants bénéficient ainsi des ressources les plus récentes et des dernières solutions du marché pour leur apprentissage, y compris des versions "early adopter" à tester avant leur mise à disposition générale.

Nos engagements :

Après avoir mis en place une politique interne solide en termes de RSE, nous avons souhaité mettre nos compétences au service de projets orientés développement durable. Une initiative dédiée est née : AVISIA Impact.

Cette initiative est ainsi notre réponse pour apporter une contribution directe (via nos projets) et indirecte (via la formation de nos équipes) aux enjeux de transformation durable. Nous voulons ainsi faciliter l’émergence des futurs acteurs de la transformation et accélérer le rythme du changement.

Pour plus d'information sur ces initiatives data au service de la transformation durable, n'hésitez pas à consulter notre page dédiée.

Nous recherchons donc des talents ayant :

  • Ayant un excellent relationnel,

  • Avec la volonté de s'impliquer sur la réussite de projet client,

  • Dotés d’un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse,

  • Qui accordent une importance particulière à la qualité des livrables ainsi qu’à la présentation,

  • Curieux et soucieux de se tenir informé des évolutions du marché,

  • Avec l’envie de continuer à apprendre pour être acteur de leur progression.

Les compétences :

Vous êtes en dernière année de formation data à l’université ou en grande école et disposez des compétences suivantes :

  • Connaissance des grands principes sur le cycle de vie de la donnée (Collecte, Ingestion, Stockage, DataViz...)

  • Bonne connaissance du SQL et de Python,

  • Des notions sur les plateformes technologiques telles que Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake ou Databricks.

title: Data Scientist, Lab & Protein Data
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

You'll build out the data science layer of Adaptyv's foundry — the work that turns tens of thousands of raw, messy experimental readouts into clean, trustworthy, structured data that our customers, our models, and our own scientists can rely on. Binding (BLI/SPR), developability, biophysical, and functional assays all produce data at scale; your job is to make that data correct, comparable, and useful.

This sits at the intersection of three things: data quality (is this number real, or an artifact?), bioinformatics (linking experimental results back to sequence, structure, and protein design), and dataset building (turning foundry output into the kind of high-quality, benchmarkable data that frontier AI labs actually want). You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the lab scientists who run the assays, the software team who own the pipelines, and the customers who train models on what we produce. This is a hands-on build role, not a management one.

What You'll Do

  • Own the scientific logic of data quality across the foundry: define what "good data" looks like for each assay type — expected signal ranges, control thresholds, failure modes, edge cases — and turn it into automated checks.

  • Build anomaly detection and QC models that catch bad data the eye would miss: assay drift, instrument variability, plate effects, false passes and false fails — and distinguish real signal from noise statistically.

  • Work with the software and ML teams to specify, review, and improve the automated data pipelines that process instrument outputs, feeding back precise requirements for what to flag, auto-reject, or route to human review.

  • Connect experimental results back to the protein side — sequence, structure, and design — so wet-lab data and computational models reinforce each other.

  • Turn foundry output into structured, documented, benchmark-grade datasets that are a genuine asset for our customers and for training and evaluating protein-design models.

  • Apply real statistical rigor to multi-condition data at scale — thousands of samples across hundreds of simultaneous experiments — and make the results interpretable and comparable across runs.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong data science / bioinformatics background — you're fluent in Python (pandas, numpy, the scientific stack) and comfortable owning messy, real-world experimental data end to end.

  • Genuine biology grounding — you understand proteins, assays, and sequence/structure/function well enough to know what the data means, not just how to process it. You don't need to be a bench scientist, but you can't be biology-blind.

  • Statistical maturity — process control, anomaly detection, handling variability and batch effects; you can tell drift from noise and defend the call.

  • Prolific builder with the receipts to prove it. You've shipped a lot — pipelines, tools, models, datasets — and can point to concrete things you built end to end and put into real use, not prototypes that died in a notebook. You move fast, systematize what works, and have no patience for babysitting a fixed dashboard.

  • AI-native builder. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce.

  • Interdisciplinary by instinct. You're energized working across the lab bench, software, and ML, and you treat automation and data infrastructure as part of your job.

  • Bonus: experience with protein/sequence-structure data (bioinformatics tooling, structural data), ML on experimental data, or building datasets for model training and benchmarking.

Details

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow.

In a nutshell

  • Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed).

  • Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale.

  • Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics.

  • Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression.

  • Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events.

About Kaizo

At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing.

The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in.

What you'll focus on

  • Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably.

  • Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics.

  • Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume.

  • Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable.

  • Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions.

  • Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality).

  • Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product.

What you'll grow into

  • Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time.

  • Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation.


  • A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus).

  • Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data.

  • Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus.

  • An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume.

  • Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations.

  • 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply.

  • A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling

  • Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes

  • Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation

  • Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs

Who you'll work with

You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast.

What's in it for you?

  • An office in the heart of Amsterdam, with the flexibility of hybrid working

  • Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates

  • Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desk, chair, whatever you need

  • Flexible working schedule and an open holiday policy

  • Fun workations and team events

  • A clear growth path into Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer roles

title: Data Engineer Kapitaalmarkten
description:
Als allround Data Engineer binnen de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK) ontwerp, bouw en beheer je betrouwbare datapipelines en datasets voor het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten. Daarnaast help je onze ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen en het gebruik van Databricks verder te professionaliseren. Je ontsluit, structureert en prepareert gegevens voor data-analisten, toezichthouders en andere gebruikers. Binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving werk je met grote hoeveelheden gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data, variërend van miljoenen tot miljarden records. De gegevens bevinden zich onder meer in Databricks, SQL-databases en Azure Storage. Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare ETL-processen en zorgt dat data vindbaar, controleerbaar en geschikt is voor analyse en toezicht. Je verbetert de ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen met versiebeheer, geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD in Azure DevOps. Met Declarative Automation Bundles leg je Databricks-code, configuraties en resources vast en deploy je deze gecontroleerd naar verschillende omgevingen. Hierbij werk je aan herhaalbare en beter beheersbare wijzigingen en deployments. Bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen pas je de geldende kaders voor security, privacy en governance toe. Je draagt bij aan monitoring en kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform, in samenwerking met de verantwoordelijke platform-, architectuur- en securityspecialisten. Daarnaast ontwikkel je duurzame dataproducten en draag je actief bij aan kennisdeling, innovatie en standaardisatie binnen het team.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving en op het Databricks-platform met onder andere Databricks Jobs, Azure Data Factory en PySpark/SQL. 

  • Inrichten en verbeteren van geautomatiseerde ontwikkel-, test- en deploymentprocessen met CI/CD in Azure DevOps. 

  • Vastleggen en gecontroleerd deployen van Databricks-code, configuraties en resources met Declarative Automation Bundles.

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van datapipelines en deploymentprocessen voor machinelearningtoepassingen en bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van MLOps binnen het Databricks-platform.

  • Toepassen van kaders en standaarden voor datakwaliteit, security, privacy en governance, waaronder het gebruik van Unity Catalog. 

  • Monitoren en verbeteren van de werking en betrouwbaarheid van datapipelines en bijdragen aan kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform. 

  • Actief bijdragen aan architectuurvraagstukken rondom schaalbaarheid, security, data governance en cloudinrichting. 

  • Samenwerken met data-analisten, datamanagementspecialisten en platform engineers om technische en functionele vraagstukken te vertalen naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen. 

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en actief bijdragen aan innovatie, standaardisatie en kennisdeling binnen het team.

Afdeling en team

Je maakt deel uit van de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK), waar we data inzetten om het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten te versterken. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team met onder andere data-analisten, datamanagementspecialisten en een integrator. Samen ontwikkelen we betrouwbare datasets, analyses en informatieproducten voor toezichtsvraagstukken. Je werkt daarnaast nauw samen met experts op het gebied van toezicht, financiële markten en technologie. Binnen de afdeling is er ruimte om je vakinhoudelijk te ontwikkelen, kennis te delen en nieuwe werkwijzen toe te passen. Zo draag je samen met het team bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van datagedreven toezicht.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ WO-werk- en -denkniveau en minimaal drie jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie binnen een Azure-cloudomgeving.

⭐ Data Engineering: Ruime ervaring met Databricks, PySpark en SQL en met het ontwikkelen en beheren van schaalbare processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking.

⭐ Azure: Ervaring met Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage en andere relevante Azure-diensten voor gegevensverwerking.

⭐ DevOps en automatisering: Ervaring met Git, Azure DevOps en CI/CD en inzicht in het gecontroleerd, herhaalbaar en geautomatiseerd testen en deployen van dataoplossingen.

⭐ Databricks-ontwikkeling: Ervaring met of kennis van Declarative Automation Bundles en Unity Catalog.

⭐ MLOps: Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van datapipelines, herbruikbare componenten of deploymentprocessen voor machinelearningtoepassingen, of de motivatie om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen.

⭐ Security en governance: Je kunt kaders voor identity and access management, databeveiliging, privacy en governance toepassen bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen.

⭐ Monitoring: Ervaring met het monitoren van datapipelines, analyseren van verstoringen en verbeteren van prestaties en betrouwbaarheid.

⭐ Datamodellering: Kennis van relationele en dimensionele datamodellering, waaronder normalisatie en de principes van Inmon en Kimball.

⭐ Werkwijze: Je werkt iteratief, neemt eigenaarschap en zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega’s en andere disciplines.

⭐ Persoonlijke eigenschappen: Je bent analytisch, initiatiefrijk en gericht op het ontwikkelen van duurzame oplossingen.

Pre:

  • Relevante certificeringen op het gebied van Databricks, Azure Data Engineering of DevOps.

The Role

You'll work cross-functionally with internal and external science, engineering, and product teams to deliver high-impact AI solutions.

 

What You Will Do

  • Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art models on large clusters.

  • Generate and curate datasets for theorem proving and software verification, and build evaluators and benchmarks for formal reasoning.

  • Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases.

  • Manage research projects and communications with client research teams.

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.

  • Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

  • Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry.

  • Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain.
