title: Store Manager (m/w/d) - Sales & Leadership, Inneneinrichtung Bern
description:
Du liebst Sales, begeisterst Kund:innen und willst mit deinem Team echte Erfolge feiern?

Dann könnte das hier genau dein nächster Karriereschritt sein.

Bei SOFACOMPANY suchen wir keinen klassischen Store Manager – wir suchen eine echte Sales-Persönlichkeit mit Leadership-Mentalität. Jemanden, der mit Leidenschaft verkauft, sein Team motiviert, KPIs liebt und gemeinsam mit dem Team außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erreicht.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, Menschen inspirieren und Teil einer internationalen Interior-Brand werden?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Store Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Store in Bern.

Über uns

SOFACOMPANY ist ein erfolgreiches dänisches Interior-Unternehmen mit Stores in über zehn Ländern. Seit 2016 steuern wir unsere DACH-Region von Berlin aus und wachsen kontinuierlich weiter.

Unsere Mission: Hochwertiges Design zu fairen Preisen zugänglich machen.

Neben unserem starken Onlinegeschäft sind unsere modernen Stores ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres einzigartigen Omnichannel-Konzepts. Hier schaffen wir inspirierende Kundenerlebnisse und machen Wohnträume wahr.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst und motivierst dein Team, um gemeinsam starke Verkaufsziele zu erreichen
  • Du bist aktiv im Recruiting sowie im Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender eingebunden
  • Du schaffst eine positive Teamkultur im Einklang mit den SOFACOMPANY-Werten
  • Du planst dein Team effizient mit einer appgestützten Personaleinsatzplanung
  • Du analysierst KPIs und entwickelst deinen Store strategisch weiter
  • Du setzt Verkaufsstrategien aktiv um und sorgst für ein exzellentes Kundenerlebnis
  • Als Vorbild auf der Fläche lebst du unsere Vision im täglichen Kundenkontakt vor
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Zentrale in Berlin zusammen

Qualifikation

  • Du brennst für Sales und liebst es, Menschen zu begeistern
  • Idealerweise hast du erste Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung
  • Deine Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Einstellung stehen für uns an erster Stelle
  • Du besitzt starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und gehst proaktiv auf Menschen zu
  • Du arbeitest KPI-orientiert und möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln
  • Regelmäßige Samstagsarbeit ist für dich selbstverständlich
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch
  • Kundenservice und Verkauf sind deine Leidenschaft

title: GTM Operations Manager
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role

We’re looking for a GTM Operations Manager to build and improve the workflows that connect our go-to-market teams.

A promising account signs up. Does the right person find out, with enough context to act? A customer becomes eligible for a new product. Do they receive useful guidance? A data sync fails overnight. Do we catch it before it affects a campaign, account handoff, or business decision?

You’ll help make those things work reliably.

You’ll join an existing GTM Operations team, working closely with @Nathan Bellehsen on Salesforce and Sales systems and @Masha Tsaryk on Marketing and customer-lifecycle systems. Your initial focus will be lead handoffs and lifecycle execution: the data, automation, quality checks, and reporting that turn customer signals into useful action.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You’ll own agreed projects from understanding the problem through building, testing, rollout, and ongoing improvement. Experienced teammates will provide context, help set priorities, and partner with you on architectural decisions. Within that direction, we expect you to make progress independently and flag problems early.

Our stack includes Salesforce, Customer.io, Clay, Looker, automation tools, and a growing set of AI workflows. You don’t need to know every tool. You do need to understand how systems connect and enjoy figuring out why something isn’t working.

Why we’re hiring for this role now

RevenueCat’s GTM organization is growing across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Growth. We’re developing more deliberate ways to identify promising accounts, help customers adopt our products, and turn successful one-to-one work into programs that reach many more people.

Our operations team already supports the systems behind that work. We need more capacity to take important workflows from “this could work” to something dependable that people use every day.

You’ll help us ship those improvements while making the existing operation easier to run: fewer manual handoffs, clearer ownership, more trustworthy data, and less time spent solving the same problem twice.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Own selected GTM workflows end-to-end. Translate a business problem into a practical solution, agree how success will be measured, build and test it, and stay responsible after launch.

  • Make lead and account handoffs dependable. Build and improve enrichment, qualification, routing, alerts, and follow-up visibility. Help ensure important signals reach a named owner, and make missed or failed handoffs visible.

  • Put lifecycle programs into production. Partner with Marketing and Customer Growth on audience definitions, triggers, exclusions, data syncs, campaign QA, and measurement. Turn repeatable requests into workflows and templates teammates can use.

  • Keep data connected and usable. Trace how account, contact, and product-usage data moves between systems. Investigate stale records, duplicates, mismatched relationships, and failed syncs; fix what you can and work with the relevant system or Data owner on deeper issues.

  • Build automation that holds up in everyday use. Test realistic scenarios and edge cases, monitor failures, and make it clear how to recover when something breaks. Bring consequential changes to the relevant system owner before rollout.

  • Use AI where it improves the work. Build or improve workflows for tasks such as enrichment, research, qualification, and quality checks. Evaluate the output, understand the failure modes, and measure whether the result saves time or improves quality.

  • Make what you build understandable and useful. Document your workflows, enable the people using them, gather feedback, and improve adoption. Share knowledge so another teammate can operate and troubleshoot your work. Keep documentation current as workflows change, and fill gaps in the existing processes you take on.

  • Make operational performance visible. Build and maintain reports that help teams understand workflow health, handoff gaps, campaign execution, and adoption. Work with senior Ops teammates and Data on consistent definitions.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in GTM, revenue, marketing, sales, or customer operations.

  • Practical Salesforce experience. You understand objects, relationships, fields, flows, and how data moves through the system. You have built or changed things yourself.

  • Experience building in a marketing automation platform such as Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, or Iterable, including segmentation, triggers, and integrations.

  • Experience building something useful with AI. You can explain the problem, your contribution, how you checked the result, what failed, and what you changed. A sanitized walkthrough is welcome; we don’t expect confidential work from a previous employer.

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical judgment. You can trace a problem across systems, check your assumptions against data, and distinguish a symptom from its cause.

  • Ownership and follow-through. You can take an agreed problem, work through ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver without needing every step assigned.

  • Clear written communication. You keep stakeholders informed, document decisions, and explain technical problems in language others can act on.

  • Care for the details. You think about the wrong audience, missing record, duplicate trigger, or failed handoff before it becomes someone else’s problem.

  • Learning agility and adaptability. You can transfer what you know to unfamiliar tools and adjust your plan when priorities change, while keeping commitments and stakeholders informed.

Ideally, you

  • Have worked in a product-led or usage-based business with both self-service and Sales-assisted customers.

  • Have connected CRM, marketing automation, customer-success, or product-usage systems.

  • Can use SQL, APIs, webhooks, or lightweight scripts to investigate data and connect tools.

  • Have improved adoption of an internal tool or replaced repeated manual work with a maintained workflow.

  • Have supported customer onboarding, product adoption, lifecycle education, or account-coverage programs.

What success looks like

Within the first month, you’ll:

  • Learn how customers move through RevenueCat and how our GTM teams support them.

  • Map an initial workflow with @Nathan Bellehsen and @Masha Tsaryk, including its data sources, owners, dependencies, and common failure points.

  • Ship your first useful improvement as part of RevenueCat’s “first ship” tradition.

  • Agree your initial ownership area and a prioritized set of problems to solve.

Within the first three months, you’ll:

  • Own the day-to-day operation of an agreed set of lead and/or lifecycle workflows.

  • Deliver an improvement from scoping through rollout, with clear documentation and stakeholder feedback.

  • Establish baseline measures and monitoring for the workflows you own.

  • Give another teammate enough context to support your work when you’re away.

Within the first six months, you’ll:

  • Demonstrate measurable improvement in a core workflow, such as fewer missed handoffs, faster campaign delivery, fresher data, or less manual effort.

  • Turn recurring operational requests into reusable processes.

  • Show that the people your workflows serve are using them successfully, and improve what isn’t working.

Within the first twelve months, you’ll:

  • Independently deliver projects across systems within your areas of ownership.

  • Have a track record of reliable workflows, useful automation, and improvements that make GTM teams more effective.

  • Help shape the next priorities using evidence from users, operational performance, and customer needs.

  • Be developing deeper expertise and taking on progressively more complex work.

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? title: Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager
description:
Joining Weezevent means working on tangible solutions used at international festivals (Hellfest, Boomtown, Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Boom), major sporting events (Formula 1, the Olympic Games, Euro fan zones), and high-volume live experiences.

Weezevent builds the technology behind live events: ticketing, cashless payment, CRM, staff solutions and access control. We are about 100 people in the tech team (engineering and product organisation), part of a group that has grown both organically and through acquisitions, so our teams span several countries and cultures.

We are at an inflection point. We are opening a focused 12–18 month window to invest heavily in the foundations of our main product, WeezTicket: paying down technical debt, tightening our architecture, and setting ourselves up for the next phase of growth. To run that program, we’re hiring an Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager (M/F, based in Clichy) to own its delivery.

Vos missions

This is a two-part role, and the first part is where you’ll spend most of your first year.

Part one : deliver the program. A board of our most experienced engineers is defining the architectural direction and producing a large backlog of clean-up and improvement work. That work will be delivered by several external squads brought in for the program. You own the delivery layer between them: getting squads stood up and productive on time, tracking each one’s pace and quality, and keeping the whole program on schedule.

  • Stand up and onboard external squads, around 20 developers across 5 to 6 squads, on time : access, environments, documentation, and a well-scoped first backlog ready before they start
  • Track the delivery pace of each squad against its commitments, and keep a clear program-level view of what’s on track, slipping, or blocked
  • Hold squads to the quality bar set by the architectural board : tests, reviews, and no new debt introduced while removing old debt
  • Manage cross-squad dependencies so work lands in the right order
  • Track program spend against budget and manage the relationships with the partners supplying the squads
  • Report program status to the CTO and the board on a regular cadence

Part two : become the operational backbone of engineering. As the program matures, you’ll take on the people-operations side of the organisation: helping our managers run great 1:1s and reviews, coordinating the performance cycle, keeping an eye on team capacity and wellbeing, and bringing rigour to tooling and budget. This is what makes the role a long-term home rather than a temporary program job.

You’ll work closely with the CTO, the architectural board, our 4 Team Leads, and the external partners supplying the squads. You won’t set the technical strategy or write the code, you’ll make sure the right work gets delivered, on time, at the right quality.

  • Help 4 Team Leads and 6 Squad Leads run consistent 1:1s and grow as managers
  • Coordinate the performance review cycle and make sure follow-up actions actually happen
  • Keep visibility on team capacity, absences, and early signals of overload or burnout
  • Bring structure to tech budget tracking and to the governance of our tools and licences
  • Support hiring and internal mobility alongside our recruitment team

Vos compétences

Must-haves

  • Experience running a multi-squad delivery program end to end: ideally involving external agencies, consultancies, or contract teams
  • A track record of onboarding external teams onto an existing codebase and getting them productive quickly
  • Comfort owning a backlog, a schedule, and a budget across several parallel workstreams at once
  • The ability to track pace and quality per team and raise problems early, with data
  • Genuine tech literacy: you understand what developers do, can navigate a Jira board, and know what technical debt actually means
  • Fluent French and English

What makes you a strong long-term fit

  • Some experience coaching or supporting managers, or running a performance cycle in a tech company
  • A background that touched engineering, delivery, project management, or product before moving toward operations
  • Analytical rigour: you’re comfortable with numbers, dashboards, and cost reports
  • Direct, honest communication and real discretion with sensitive information

Nice to have

  • A third language (German or Dutch is a real plus given our footprint)
  • Experience working across France, the UK, the Netherlands, or Germany, and an understanding of how management styles differ across them

This is not

  • A role that sets architecture or writes code; that’s the board and the squads
  • A pure recruiter or a corporate-HR profile with no delivery or engineering exposure
  • A process-for-process’s-sake job. We want impact, not bureaucracy

The recruitment process

  • HR interview - background and soft skills
  • Interview with CTO - technical discussion

All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Why it's a good move

You’ll run a high-visibility program with the direct backing of the CTO and the most senior engineers in the company, in an organisation that has decided to genuinely invest in its technical foundations rather than just talk about it. And when the program lands, you’ll have built yourself a permanent, central role at the heart of how our engineering organisation runs.

title: Accountant
description:
Accountant

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

Our Mission For You

Help us build an in-house accounting function from the ground up. trawa is bringing its bookkeeping in-house, and you'll be one of the people who makes that work: clean books, on time, every month.

trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're a hyper-growth energy-tech company with strong team growth, backed by Balderton Capital, Speedinvest and Headline. Our business model sits at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance, which makes our accounting more complex and more interesting than a typical start-up ledger.

You'll start hands-on with day-to-day accounting and keep the books clean as volumes grow. At the same time, you'll spot the manual steps in your work and get room to automate them. You'll also be part of our ERP rollout. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own their area, not just process it.

What You'll Own

Accounts Payable

  • Process, check, and post incoming invoices from Moss into DATEV, including correct VAT treatment

  • Handle expenses and credit card bookings

  • Maintain vendor master data and keep supplier accounts reconciled

  • Prepare payment runs

Month-End Support

  • Reconcile bank transactions

  • Prepare accruals and reconciliations for your areas

  • Support the monthly close and year-end, working with our auditors

  • Keep documentation GoBD-compliant and audit-ready

  • Partner with Ops, Procurement and budget owners to resolve invoice and cost questions

Build & Improve

  • Spot manual steps in your processes and automate them

  • Contribute to our ERP rollout



Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, ideally in accounts payable

  • Comfortable when processes don't exist yet. You help create them instead of waiting for them

  • Solid understanding of German GAAP (HGB) and VAT basics

  • Precise and fast. You care about getting it right and getting it done

  • Analytical and confident in Excel or Google Sheets for reconciliations

  • Fluent in English

Nice-to-haves

  • German is a strong plus (B1 or better): most of our vendor invoices and much of our supplier communication are in German

  • Experience in a fast-growing company (start-up or scale-up), or at a tax firm serving start-up clients

  • Hands-on with DATEV Rechnungswesen and DATEV Unternehmen online (DUO)

  • Training as Steuerfachangestellte/r or Kaufmann/-frau

  • Experience with Moss or similar spend management tools

  • Automation experience or strong tech curiosity: you've built workflows with n8n, Zapier, or Make, or used Claude Code or similar AI tools

Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Learn

  • Understand our business model, our accounting setup, and our tools (Moss, DATEV). Take over your first recurring bookings.

Month 2: Own

  • Run accounts payable and bank postings independently. Support your first month-end close.

Month 3: Improve

  • Deliver your areas on time each month. Propose and ship your first automation or process improvement.

The Team

You'll join a fast-growing Finance team of around ten people across Accounting, Billing, Collections, FP&A, Treasury, and Strategic Finance. You'll work closely with colleagues across these areas and see how your bookings flow into cash and planning. You'll also work cross-functionally with Business Operations, Energy, and other departments.

Why trawa?

  • Real ownership from day one. You build the accounting function from the start, not just maintain one

  • Learn fast from an experienced Senior Accountant, with direct contact to our hands-on Finance leadership team

  • A uniquely complex problem space at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance, plus a PwC audit and an ERP rollout

  • An AI-first Finance team that embraces new tools and ways of working

  • Clear growth path within our career framework: grow towards Senior Accountant, or specialise in revenue accounting or finance systems as we scale

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant office culture

Diversity at trawa

Everyone is welcome here. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values diversity, and we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, physical or neurodiverse background.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We value ownership, learning speed, and hunger over a perfect CV.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Hi, I'm Serhii, I'm the Accounting Team Lead at WeTravel, and I'm hiring the Senior Accountant to take over the work I've done for the past three years.

I joined as a Junior Accountant, took on this scope early, and grew into leading the accounting

team. That path is real here: if you own your work and keep improving how it gets done, scope

follows. You'll report to me, and I'll be your day-to-day partner, reviewer and someone to think

problems through with.

How we work

We're a small team, so your work is visible and your ideas get used. We value autonomy: you get clear ownership, not a checklist and someone looking over your shoulder.

We care about the "how" as much as the "what." We write standard operating procedures (SOPs), build reusable workpapers, script repetitive NetSuite tasks and use AI tools daily to move faster. If you've ever rebuilt a reconciliation so the next month took half the time, you'll fit in. We're remote-first. Our finance team works mostly from home, split between Amsterdam and the US, so you'll collaborate across time zones. You and I will meet at our Amsterdam office for in-person days, such as working sessions, close kick-offs and planning. How often depends on what the work needs, and we keep it flexible. The office is open every day if you'd rather work from there. You'll need to live in the Netherlands, within reach of Amsterdam.

Our values:

• Be Respectful: we build an inclusive team that values different perspectives.

• Be Honest: we default to transparency, including when something in the numbers is wrong.

• Be Resourceful: we find a way forward even when the path isn't mapped out.

• Be the Solution: spotting a problem is the start; fixing it is the job.

What you'll own

You'll own these areas end to end, from monthly entries through audit support.

• Month-end close: you'll be the main preparer of the monthly close, owning accruals, prepaids

and balance sheet reconciliations, and reviewing the income statement for accuracy, correct

periods and department mapping before it goes to final review.

• Cash: bank, card and payment-platform accounts across multiple currencies and entities,

including Stripe, Airwallex, ING and Corpay.

• Intercompany: intercompany entries and loan agreements with interest between entities.

• Leases and fixed assets: lease accounting (right-of-use assets and liabilities), leasehold

improvements, fixed assets, intangibles and depreciation.

• Compensation: bonus and commission accruals, payroll journal entries and liabilities, pension

and 401(k).

• Expenses and AP: the full expense cycle, from vendor bills and card spend to prepaid

amortization, AP tie-outs and department mapping.

• VAT: preparing BV VAT returns for review.

• Audits: owning your areas in the annual financial audit and tax reviews.

• Process: documenting and improving what you own, from standard operating procedures

(SOPs) to automation.

• Reporting: presenting your areas to the finance team in a weekly review.

We care most about how you work, then what you know. Audit firm or in-house, scale-up or

corporate: your background matters less than what you've owned.

Why You Should or Shouldn't Apply

You should apply if you have:

• A track record of owning close areas end to end without needing someone to drive them.

• 3+ years in accounting, with hands-on month-end close experience.

• Multi-entity and multi-currency experience, including intercompany.

• Solid grounding in accrual accounting; US GAAP experience, or the willingness to get there

quickly alongside Dutch GAAP.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with a mid-market ERP (NetSuite ideal).

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

• A bachelor's degree in accounting or finance, or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-haves

• NetSuite and Ramp experience.

• Dutch VAT or statutory reporting exposure.

• Examples of processes you've automated or documented, with or without AI tools.

• Interest in growing your scope and responsibilities over time.

You shouldn't apply if:

• You prefer a role where every process is fully documented and never changes.

• You need regular check-ins to keep month-end tasks moving.

• You'd rather flag a problem than dig in and propose a fix.

• You're uncomfortable explaining your numbers, or saying when you got something wrong.

Benefits

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy — enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

  • Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.

  • Monday and Thursday lunches and after-work social events.

  • Beautiful office in central Amsterdam – rooftop garden

  • Extensive paid family leave.

  • Three paid volunteer days per year — take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

  • Employer-sponsored pension plan with a 2% employer contribution deposited into your individual pension account.

  • Access to a 10% group discount on supplementary/additional health insurance (aanvullende verzekeringen), with the same discount available to eligible family members.

  • Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

title: Management Accountant
description:
Management Accountant

🌟 Position: Management Accountant (Qualified / Nearly Qualified)

📍 Location: Hybrid – London office and home working

💼 Type: Full-time

📅 Start Date: Immediate

💰 Salary: £45k to £60k

About Cooper Moss Rutland

Cooper Moss Rutland (CMR) is an independent, award-winning project controls consultancy supporting some of the UK's most complex construction and infrastructure programmes.

We provide specialist expertise across project controls, planning, cost, risk, change, reporting and data, working across rail, highways, aviation, defence, nuclear, energy and water.

We are a growing business with an ambitious outlook. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial and focused on delivering high-quality work for our clients, while creating an environment where our people can develop and make a genuine impact.

The Role

We are looking for a Management Accountant to take ownership of the core financial processes that underpin our growing business.

This is a hands-on role covering the mechanics of our finance function: month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, VAT, the timesheet-to-invoice process and the production of accurate, timely management accounts.

You would be joining a function that has grown quickly and has room to improve. We want someone who will run the core processes reliably and then make them better, rather than accepting them as they are. You would be the in-house finance lead, working with our external accountants and, where needed, senior finance support.

This would suit someone who is qualified or nearly qualified, has strong technical accounting fundamentals and enjoys being close to the detail while also understanding the wider commercial picture.

Key Responsibilities

Month-End & Management Accounts

  • Own and manage the month-end close process from start to finish.

  • Prepare accurate and timely monthly management accounts.

  • Prepare and post month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and other adjustments.

  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts and investigate and resolve discrepancies.

  • Provide clear financial information and commentary to the leadership team.

  • Prepare monthly cash flow forecasts and support the annual budgeting cycle.

Revenue, Billing & WIP

  • Own the timesheet-to-invoice process, from approved timesheets through to invoices issued.

  • Raise client invoices in line with each client's billing arrangements, which vary considerably by client and by platform.

  • Maintain revenue accruals and monitor unbilled work, keeping WIP and the cash conversion cycle under control.

  • Run credit control and follow up overdue balances.

  • Monitor timesheet submissions and chase employees for missing or incomplete timesheets ahead of each month-end.

Accounts Payable, Payments & Cash

  • Manage the accounts payable process, ensuring supplier invoices are accurately recorded and appropriately authorised.

  • Maintain accurate supplier records and resolve supplier queries and invoice discrepancies.

  • Process employee expenses and company credit card transactions, checking them against policy and chasing missing receipts.

  • Prepare and process supplier payment runs.

  • Support cash flow management and ensure key payment obligations are met on time.

VAT & Compliance

  • Prepare and submit VAT returns accurately and on time.

  • Ensure VAT treatment is applied correctly across transactions.

  • Support the year-end accounts process and CMR's external accountants.

  • Work with the external accountants (and any fractional senior finance support) on year-end, tax and technical accounting matters, escalating judgement calls rather than deciding them alone.

Financial Control & Reporting

  • Perform regular bank, control account and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Identify errors, inconsistencies and control issues and take ownership of resolving them.

  • Support the development and maintenance of appropriate financial controls and processes.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Qualified or nearly qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

  • Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals and double-entry bookkeeping.

  • Practical experience of month-end accounting and preparation of management accounts.

  • Experience with accruals, prepayments, journals and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Experience preparing or supporting VAT returns.

  • Strong Excel skills and experience with Xero or a similar accounting system.

  • A proactive approach, with the confidence to investigate issues rather than simply flagging them.

  • At least two years' experience working in industry rather than solely in practice.

  • Experience of timesheet-based, multi-client billing and credit control.

  • Experience working as the sole or lead finance person, or the confidence to do so.

Desirable

  • Experience within professional services, consultancy, construction or another project-based business.

  • Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting and cash flow reporting.

  • Previous experience working in a growing SME environment.

The Person

We're looking for someone who is hands-on, organised and commercially aware.

You'll be comfortable getting into the detail, but you won't lose sight of the bigger picture. You will take pride in getting the numbers right, meeting deadlines and maintaining a finance function that the wider business can rely on.

You'll be comfortable in a growing business where not everything is perfectly established, and willing to say when something isn't working rather than quietly working around it.

Most importantly, you'll be someone people can trust with the numbers.

What You'll Get at CMR

  • The opportunity to play a key role in the finance function of a growing consultancy.

  • Exposure to the wider commercial and operational side of the business.

  • Support for your continued professional development and qualification.

  • A flexible/hybrid working environment.

About You

If you're a qualified or nearly qualified accountant looking for a role where you can take genuine ownership, work closely with senior stakeholders and play an important part in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

Come and help us build the finance function that supports the next stage of Cooper Moss Rutland's growth.

title: Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
description:
Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.


Job requirments:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

  • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

    • Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

    • Power BI

    • Power Pages

    • Microsoft Dataverse

    • Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

  • Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

  • Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

  • Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

  • Understanding of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, and GDPR/privacy.

  • Knowledge of Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), and requirements traceability.

  • Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management.

  • Ability to identify dependencies, clarify scope, assess gaps, and coordinate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows.

  • Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms.

  • Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation.

  • Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple features and priorities in a structured delivery environment.

title: Associate Director- Sustainability & Impact (Lyon, France)
tags: Business Analyst, Venture Capital & Private Equity, Archimed
description:
Location : Lyon, France

About ARCHIMED:

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools & Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team

• An international team (with more than 30 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors

• Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.

• Professional backgrounds: Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, capiton), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Pharmacy, Veterinary)


Your Role

Portfolio engagement and value creation

  • Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes.
  • Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required.
  • Develop and oversee the execution of actionable S&I roadmaps for each portfolio company, with targets and milestones based on the company’s materiality analysis and aligned with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy, partnering with third-party technical experts when necessary.
  • Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices.

Investment process

  • Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations.
  • Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making.

Data, reporting, and compliance

  • Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary.
  • Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives.
  • Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency.
  • Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements.

Center of excellence and capability building

  • Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices.
  • Provide expert guidance and S&I training to management, investment, and investor relations teams to deepen integration across the business.

Requirements

  • At least 10 years’ experience building and executing sustainability strategies, preferably in private equity.
  • Proven hands-on leadership, initiative, and project management skills, with strong problem-solving ability.
  • Robust knowledge of S&I frameworks and disclosures, including SFDR, SASB, CSRD, EDCI, PMDR, and the UN SDGs.
  • Strong command of impact measurement methodologies, including developing and reporting on impact metrics.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to build coherent sustainability narratives and proofread content.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the adaptability to engage C-suite executives internationally.
  • Proven team player, able to build working partnerships and promote collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Ability to coach junior team members, sharing knowledge and giving regular feedback.
  • Pragmatic, constructive, creative, and solution-oriented, with a positive mindset and the ability to work under varied pressures.

title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

What we offer

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn and Job Teaser, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.

  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
Senior Marketing Manager

Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible)
Competitive salary
Start date: as soon as possible

Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet.

We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework.

The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret.

  • The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story.

  • We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up.

  • Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation.

  • We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events.

  • Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs.

  • Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it.


That’s where you come in.

What this role really is

We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who:

  • Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search.

  • Turns our enterprise wins into case studies and references that open new doors.

  • Owns our review and analyst presence: a proper G2 strategy, competitor and comparison pages that convert, and support for analyst relations.

  • Gives Sales and CS the content, one-pagers, battlecards and decks that win deals and renewals.

  • Starts product marketing: positioning, launches, and clear messaging on AutoQA, Agentic QA, Insights and AI Coaching for customers and prospects.

  • Builds our brand through thought leadership, PR and executive content on the future of CX quality in an AI-agent world.

  • Owns our social channels and online reputation.

  • Defines and runs a field marketing plan, so Kaizo shows up at the international events that matter to our enterprise ICP.

  • Works with Sales on outbound and partner campaigns, including our helpdesk and Customer Service ecosystem partners.

You won’t inherit a polished machine. You’ll be the architect, the builder and the driver of Kaizo’s marketing.

The deal

  • Location: Amsterdam preferred, flexible across Europe, hybrid or remote possible.

  • Reporting: directly to Thibaud, Co-CEO, as part of the commercial leadership team.

  • Real ownership, a fast feedback loop with Sales and Product, and a seat at the table where positioning gets decided.

Why this matters

Marketing is the missing piece in Kaizo’s growth engine. The product is there, the enterprise customers are there and the deals are there. Now the market needs to know it, and we need demand that scales.

If you succeed, your fingerprints will be all over Kaizo’s next growth chapter:

  • From a handful of enterprise logos → recognised category voice

  • From inbound dependency → repeatable, multi-channel pipeline

  • From scrappy content → thought leadership

→ If you’re looking for a comfortable role with a big team, a big budget and playbooks already written, this isn’t it.
→ If you want to build the marketing engine that takes Kaizo from great product to visible market leader, let’s talk.


Who you are

  • A content-first marketer. Storytelling is your edge, not growth hacks.

  • You’ve marketed complex B2B SaaS, ideally to enterprise buyers with long sales cycles and buying committees.

  • You’re hands-on: you write, edit, brief designers, manage freelancers and run campaigns yourself.

  • You know what good marketing ops looks like, and you can get by with lean tools (we run on HubSpot).

  • You understand how AI search is changing B2B discovery, and you know how to adapt SEO and content to it.

  • Your English is native or near-native. Everything we publish has to read sharp and professional.

  • Bonus: AI, QA and CX excite you, and acronyms don’t scare you. You’re keen to learn our product, our customers’ pain points and the trends on both the CX and QA sides.

  • Bonus: experience with field events, G2 or analyst relations, or partner and ecosystem marketing.

Equal opportunities

At Kaizo, we believe diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, disability, religion or beliefs. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

title: Business Development Representative (m/w/d) - AI Agent Platform
description:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Worum es geht

Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon.

Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag.

Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung.

Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. Das heißt: Es gibt Erfahrung im Haus, an die du andocken kannst, und ein Playbook, das gerade entsteht. Welche Branchen wir angehen und mit welchen Kampagnen, verantworten unser Head of Sales und unser CRO. Dein Part ist das Gespräch, und was du dort hörst, fließt direkt in die nächste Runde ein.

Aufgaben

  • Telefon ist dein Hauptkanal. Cold Calling ist der Kern der Rolle, nicht ein Kanal unter mehreren. E-Mail und LinkedIn ergänzen die Ansprache

  • Ziellisten aus den Verticals abarbeiten, die Head of Sales und CRO festlegen. Die Listen kommen aufgebaut aus Clay und Cognism. Du priorisierst innerhalb der Liste und bereitest jeden Account kurz vor, bevor du anrufst

  • Kampagnen und Sequenzen in Lemlist setzen Head of Sales und CRO auf. Du führst sie aus und passt deinen Gesprächseinstieg im Call an dein Gegenüber an. Lemlist ist dein täglicher Arbeitsplatz, Clay und Cognism füttern ihn

  • Erstgespräche buchen, sauber vorbereiten und mit belastbarem Kontext an die Account Executives übergeben

  • Zurückspielen, was du im Markt hörst: welche Branche reagiert, welche Botschaft funktioniert, welche Einwände wiederkehren. Marketing und Sales-Leitung brauchen das

  • HubSpot sauber und aktuell halten — nicht als Selbstzweck, sondern weil Pipeline-Bewertung und Forecast darauf beruhen.

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Marketing und den AEs zu Kampagnen und Übergabekriterien

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 1,5 Jahre Outbound-Erfahrung im B2B, idealerweise SaaS oder erklärungsbedürftige IT-Lösungen. Du musst nicht alles gesehen haben, aber du solltest den Job kennen und nicht bei null anfangen — ein spürbarer Teil dieser Zeit sollte am Telefon stattgefunden haben und nicht nur in Sequenzen. Das ist keine Einstiegsposition.

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher auf muttersprachnahem Niveau (C2), Englisch mindestens C1. Beides täglich. Der Maßstab ist das Telefonat: Du führst auf Englisch ein Kaltgespräch, reagierst auf Einwände und hältst den Small Talk davor und danach aus, ohne dass die Sprache zum Thema wird. Wir hören uns das im Prozess an.

  • Du kannst nachvollziehbar erklären, warum deine Ansprache funktioniert hat — mit Zahlen und mit einer Begründung, nicht mit Bauchgefühl.

  • Du kommst mit Geschäftsführerinnen und Inhabern zurecht. Im Mittelstand hast du häufig direkt die Person am Telefon, die entscheidet — und die dir drei Minuten gibt, bevor sie wieder in den Betrieb muss. Erst in größeren Häusern sprichst du mit Fachbereichsleitungen und gelegentlich mit der IT.

  • Recherchefähigkeit: Du findest heraus, wer in einem Unternehmen ein Problem hat, bevor du zum Hörer greifst.

  • Selbstorganisation: Du strukturierst deine Woche selbst und brauchst keine tägliche Ansage, um in die Aktivität zu kommen.

  • Ein realistisches Verhältnis zu Ablehnung. Der größte Teil deiner Versuche führt zu nichts. Das ist normal und sollte dich weder überraschen noch aus der Ruhe bringen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM und Sales-Engagement-Tools. Unser Stack ist HubSpot, Lemlist, Clay und Cognism — genau diese Tools musst du nicht kennen, vergleichbare schon.

  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools. Recherche verdichten, Textvarianten durchspielen, ein Unternehmen vor dem Call in fünf Minuten verstehen — das geht heute schneller, wenn man weiß wie. Wir erwarten keine Zertifikate, aber auch niemanden, der ChatGPT einmal ausprobiert und wieder weggelegt hat.

  • Von Vorteil: Du hast schon aktiv nach Großbritannien akquiriert und kennst den Unterschied im Gesprächseinstieg. Ebenfalls hilfreich: Erfahrung mit Low-Code/No-Code-, ERP-, CRM- oder Datenbankthemen.

Formale Abschlüsse sind uns weniger wichtig als belastbare Outbound-Praxis. Wenn du das kannst, interessiert uns dein Studienfach nicht.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • 60.000 – 70.000 € Zieljahresgehalt (OTE) bei einem Split von 70 % Fixum und 30 % variabel. Der variable Anteil hängt an Kriterien, die du beeinflussen kannst, und ist erreichbar geplant. Den Plan legen wir vor Vertragsunterschrift offen.

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Produkt, ICP, Einwände und Gesprächsleitfäden in den ersten Wochen — plus regelmäßige 1:1s und Call-Reviews statt Zurufmanagement.

  • Kurze Wege. Du berichtest an Tim Genkinger, unseren Head of Sales, und hast direkten Zugang zu den Menschen, die über Produkt und Go-to-Market entscheiden.

  • 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG-Ticket und weitere Benefits.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte.

  • Ein Stack, der die Arbeit tatsächlich trägt: HubSpot als CRM, Lemlist für Sequenzen, Clay für Listenaufbau und Anreicherung, Cognism für belastbare Telefonnummern. Dazu KI-Assistenz als fester Teil des Arbeitsalltags, bei uns Claude, für Recherche, Textvarianten und Call-Vorbereitung. Du verbringst deine Zeit mit Gesprächen und nicht mit der Suche nach Durchwahlen. Fehlt im Stack etwas, reden wir darüber.

  • Ein Unternehmen, klein genug, dass deine Ergebnisse sichtbar sind, und groß genug, dass sie etwas bewegen.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist

  • Kein Inbound. Anfragen aus Produkt und Marketing laufen an anderer Stelle. Es gibt keine eingehenden Leads und keine Messelisten zum Nachfassen.

  • Kein Closing. Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss liegen bei den AEs. Die Stelle ist als Outbound-Rolle ausgeschrieben, nicht als Durchgangsstation — wohin es danach geht, entscheidet sich über Ergebnisse und nicht über eine Zusage im Bewerbungsgespräch.

  • Keine Führungsrolle. Du baust kein Team auf und führst niemanden.

  • Keine reine Remote-Rolle. Wir hätten dich gern etwa zwei Tage pro Woche im Büro, im Haus sind das meist Dienstag bis Donnerstag. Mehr ist willkommen, weniger im Einzelfall auch machbar. Berlin als Lebensmittelpunkt setzen wir voraus.

  • Kein Produkt, das sich von selbst erklärt. Ninox ist keine Wissenschaft — in einer Demo versteht fast jeder, was es tut. Der Aufhänger liegt trotzdem nie im Produkt, sondern beim Gegenüber: das Excel-Konstrukt, das niemand mehr pflegen kann, die Standardsoftware, die nicht passt. Darauf musst du Lust haben.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einer Ansprache, die funktioniert hat: wen du angesprochen hast, warum genau so, was dabei herauskam und was du daraus für den nächsten Versuch mitgenommen hast. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Unser Prozess besteht aus drei Terminen:

  1. Erstgespräch mit Tim Genkinger, Head of Sales und Hiring Manager dieser Rolle.

  2. Case Study. Du bekommst vorab eine Aufgabe und stellst sie Tim und Michael Blazek, unserem CRO, vor. Teile davon führen wir auf Englisch.

  3. Meet the Team. Du lernst die Kolleginnen und Kollegen kennen, mit denen du täglich arbeiten wirst.

Danach entscheiden wir. Wir halten den Prozess bewusst kurz und melden uns bei jeder Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.

Ninox steht für ein Arbeitsumfeld ohne Diskriminierung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.
